prompt: Read text. Uppercase it, replace each 'A' with '*', then append 'a'.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.REPLACE(strings.UPPER(text),"A","*"),"a")).

prompt: Read text. Trim spaces, reverse it, then prefix 'a:'.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT("a:",strings.REVERSE(strings.TRIM(text," ")))).

prompt: Read left|right text fields. Count 'a' in right and add the length of left; print the number.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
NUMBER count=strings.COUNT(right,"a").
DISPLAYNL(count+strings.LENGTH(left)).

prompt: Read left|right text fields. Print 'a:' followed by the longer field; choose right on a tie.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
IF (strings.LENGTH(left)>strings.LENGTH(right)) { DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT("a:",left)). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT("a:",right)). }
